boundary: The generic nonzero duration counter is decremented for every active status on every valid unit at side end, before the side bit toggles. Duration-zero preparation semantics, status-specific periodic effects, immediate one-shot reactions, and battle-start initialization remain separate rules.
conclusion: At state 0x1100 the original ROM decrements every active status duration for units 1 through 12 before toggling sides. Duration 2 becomes 1 and remains active; duration 1 reaches zero and the complete slot is removed.
method: Validate the state-0x1100 call order and status-slot decrement loop, then compare two original-ROM side-end replays whose only controlled differences are one status code and duration 1 or 2.
